summary: CXApp Inc. (CXAI), through its Australian subsidiary CXAI Australia Pty Ltd, acquired 100% of Virtus Digital Marketing Pty Ltd (EngineRoom), an AI-enabled growth intelligence platform. The aggregate purchase price was approximately $4.6 million, comprising ~$2.99 million cash (65%), up to ~$1.15 million performance-based earnout (25%) tied to 24-month revenue targets, and ~$460,000 escrow (10%). The transaction closed simultaneously on June 3, 2026, with CXAI providing parent support for payment obligations. Expected to add ~$8.1M annual revenue (94% recurring) and ~$1.6M adjusted EBITDA, raising CXAI's annualized run-rate from ~$4M to >$12M. Risk-arb: low break risk given simultaneous signing and close; focus on earnout achievement.
